source_sections.theme: concept as the shared decision foundation; AI accelerates execution but does not choose the governing concept
start from observed demand and recurring demand patterns rather than creator preference
extract actor-specific advantage from story, values, recurring behavior and overcome-experience
use competitor analysis to locate an unserved position rather than imitate surface features
target resolution; distinguish stated wants from inferred deeper needs; identify previously failed solutions
compose demand, uniqueness, position and target into an upstream concept connected to the downstream product/outcome
one semantic core, multiple channel-specific representations
publish hypotheses, observe who responded to which wording, analyze, deepen winners and retest weak variants
base strategy inputs: product/service, target current problem, desired future, unique solution
launch-wide concept: title, problem, benefit, why-you, why-now, abstraction check
numeric goal, business phase, phase-dependent funnel/policy selection, D-Day
downstream prelaunch, lead magnet, video, landing-page and offer artifacts repeatedly consume named upstream strategy outputs

rejected_as_universal_doctrine: Why/What/How/Action as a mandatory universal sequence
authority or personal story as proof of factual correctness
latent customer needs inferred from persuasion theory as observed fact
claims that one targeting or messaging strategy is universal
